name: Bot Deck for Grok Bot
description: Unofficial sidebar client for your Grok Bot bots: pick a bot, chat, create and delete bots, and schedule tasks. Uses the gbot CLI and your signed-in Grok Bot desktop app.

settings.title: gbot path
settings.description: Full path to the gbot (grok-bot-cli) executable. Leave empty to find it on PATH and in the usual npm and Homebrew folders.
